LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip0: Create a new object list. You pick its structures.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip1: Create a new, empty loot table. It reaches the file only when you save.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip2: Create a new container, with images for full and empty.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_PickOne: Pick an entry on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_OpenFileTip: Opens the file in your text editor. The editor reloads changes made there on its own.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_ListHintTables: Red means: nothing in the table exists in the game.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NoParents: No other table draws this one.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FallbackTip: If this table yields nothing, the one picked here is drawn instead.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FileOnly: Only editable in the file, kept when saving: {0}
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_DisplayTip: Fill: containers are filled with loot. Empty: they are just furniture.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_PawnInsideHint: With a pawn list someone can jump out when it is opened.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_EditContainerTip: Opens the container window with this one as the template.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FooterHint: Changes reach the file only when you save.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_SampleTip: Draws the saved table a few times and shows the result.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip3: Create a new crop list. It reaches the file only when you save.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_CropHint: Fields and pens that name this list draw their plants from it by weight. A change here affects all of them.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_CropEmpty: No plants in the list yet.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_CropUnused: No field and no pen names this list.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_CropRightHint: In the Settlement tab you pick the list for each field and pen. Without a list, the individually chosen plants apply there.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_CropNoProject: The mod folder was not found.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip4: Create a new material list. It inherits from the base list and reaches the file only when you save.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_NewTip5: Create a new floor list. It reaches the file only when you save.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_MapStoneTip: Blocks from the rock of the map tile.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_FloorMixTip: These floors are mixed by weight. You change the weights in the file.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_TagSearchTip: When no entry of the chains exists, CBF looks for a thing or floor with this tag.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_Missing: {0} is not loaded. The next entry is tried.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_CriticalTip: Critical: if this role finds nothing, the whole list is unusable. Optional: the role simply stays empty.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_WardTip: Limits this row to one kind of ward. A row for the ward wins over a row without one. It affects everything resolved by role in that ward: walls, roads and floors the generator draws, and cells of pieces that name a role instead of a concrete thing. Pieces that name concrete things keep them.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_Hint: Pieces name roles instead of things. This list says what fills each role. The first existing entry of a chain wins. A role may appear in several rows, then the row that fits the piece or ward best is used.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_Empty: No roles of its own yet.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_OverrideTip: Copies the inherited rows into this list, so you can change them.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_Unused: No settlement type names this list.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_ParentTip: Roles this list does not name itself come from this list.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_RightHint: In the Settlement tab every settlement type picks its material list. Previews of single pieces use the list of the settlement type selected there.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_WALL: Outer walls of buildings and the settlement wall.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_DOOR: Doors of buildings and doors in the wall, on the walkway, in towers and posterns.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_GATE: Gate in a wall passage without a gatehouse.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_EMBRASURE: Arrow slits and embrasures in walls and towers.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_FLOOR_FINE: Floor for fine rooms such as halls and temples.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_FLOOR_ROUGH: Floor for simple rooms such as barns and workshops.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_FLOOR_ROAD: Roads, when the ward names no roads of its own.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_FLOOR_ROAD_EDGE: Strip along the edge of the roads.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_ROOF_THIN: Thin roof, for sheds and open halls.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_CONTAINER: Crates and other containers for loot.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_PEN_MARKER: Marker that turns a fenced area into an animal pen.
LanguageData.CBF_RoleTip_CONDUIT_ROAD: Conduit where it runs under roads.
LanguageData.CBF_Mat_AppliesToTip: Fortification pieces or categories this row is meant for, for example palisade walls. The row applies in wards whose walls, emplacements or gatehouses use one of them. Like Ward, it only affects what is resolved by role; pieces that name concrete things keep them.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorHint: Floor symbols of pieces that name this list draw their floor from it by weight. A change here affects all of them.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorFromMapTip: The floor is swapped for the variant made of the stone found on the map, as with floors without a list.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorMaterials: Materials, one is picked at random:
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorMaterialsTip: Only the ticked materials are used. With none ticked, exactly this floor is laid, without swapping for the map's stone.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorUnused: No piece names this list yet.
LanguageData.CBF_Lo_FloorRightHint: In the Piece tab you pick the list for each floor symbol under Floors. Without a list, the floor drawn in the piece is laid.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_NoNew: New ruins are set up in XML for now.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_Hint: Who holds a quest ruin. The other ruin fields stay in the XML file.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_Occ_BuilderTip: The faction that built the place still holds it.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_Occ_OccupierTip: The conquering faction holds the ruin, drawn from raid points.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_Occ_AnimalsTip: Aggressive animals of the biome hold the ruin as manhunters, scaled by the threat points of the site.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_CreaturesTip: A pawn list. Each entry spawns exactly one pawn, weights do not count. Animals come as manhunters.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_OpenTip: Open the pawn list in the Pawn tab.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_NoCreatures: No creatures. The occupation above decides who holds the ruin.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_EachOne: Each entry of the list is one pawn. One troll is a list with one entry, three wolves are three entries.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_Replaces: The creatures replace the occupation above.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_ListEmpty: The pawn list is empty, nothing spawns.
LanguageData.CBF_Ru_RightHint: Saving changes only occupation and creatures in the ruin's file.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_NoNew: Sites come from quests and mods, they cannot be created here.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_Hint: Which CBF settlement type a quest site builds when it is entered.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_ByCamp: Already built by CBF through the camp plan {0} (camp types). Change it there.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_ByOther: Already built by CBF with {0}, set by another file. Change it there.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_PlanTip: The settlement type the site builds. None leaves the site as it is.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_RuinTip: Optional damage and occupation from a ruin. Opens in Lists, Ruins.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_NoSteps: This site has no map steps of its own. CBF adds its own step.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_ReplaceTip: Ticked: CBF replaces this step, so it no longer builds. Unticked steps keep running next to the CBF settlement.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_NothingReplaced: No step replaced: CBF adds its own step, and the existing steps build as well.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_GoalStepTip: This step probably builds the quest goal, such as loot, a prisoner or a special building. If it is replaced, the goal is missing and the quest may not be completable.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_GoalReplaced: A replaced step probably builds the quest goal. Without it, loot, prisoners or buildings the quest needs are missing. Better leave it unchecked; CBF then builds in addition and keeps the goal area free.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_Occupier: Occupiers cannot be chosen for quests of other mods. The quest picks the faction itself.
LanguageData.CBF_Si_RightHint: Saving writes CBF_Sites.xml into Defs and Patches of your mod. The editor applies the change at once; replaced steps of other mods only come back after a restart.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_NewTip: Create a new quest from a quest kind.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_Art_Ort_raeumenTip: A settlement held by enemies. Drive them out; afterwards the player picks goodwill or the loot.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_Art_Ort_verteidigenTip: A settlement under attack. Help the defenders; the quest fails if they fall.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_Art_Verlies_erkundenTip: A dungeon with levels. Clear it or reach the bottom.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_Art_Gefangene_befreienTip: A site where enemies hold people of the quest giver captive.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_Art_MonsterjagdTip: Ruins without a faction, held by creatures from a pawn list, such as a troll.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_CreaturesTip: Opens the same picker as for pen animals: search, filter by kind and mod, pictures. The chosen creatures are saved as a pawn list.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LABELTip: Name of the site on the world map.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_DESCRIPTIONTip: Shown when the site is selected on the world map.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_QUEST_NAMETip: Name in the quest list. Grammar tags such as [asker_nameDef] are allowed.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_QUEST_DESCRIPTIONTip: Text of the quest offer. Grammar tags such as [asker_nameFull] are allowed.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_SITE_PLANTip: Which CBF settlement is built: one fixed type, or any type with a matching site tag.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_PLANTip: The dungeon plan of the site.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_GOAL_SIGNALTip: When the dungeon quest is done. Cleared: no hostile pawn is left standing on the site or any level, sleeping ones included, and no hostile turret remains. Bottom reached: a colonist enters the deepest level.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_RUINTip: Damage and occupation of the site, see Quests, Ruins.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_RUIN_PARENTTip: The ruin rules the own ruin of the quest starts from.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_PRISONERSTip: Number of prisoners as a range, for example 2~4.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_CREATURESTip: Pawn list of the creatures. Each entry is one creature.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_SITE_TEXTURETip: Icon of the site on the world map.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_OCCUPIERSTip: Factions that may hold the site. Empty means any hostile human faction.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_THREAT_MINTip: The quest only appears from these threat points on.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_POINTS_FACTORTip: Factor on the threat points for the enemies on the site.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_SELECTION_WEIGHTTip: How often the storyteller picks this quest. 0 switches it off.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_EXPIRE_DAYSTip: Days until an offer that was not accepted expires, as a range.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_TIMEOUT_DAYS_MINTip: Shortest time the site stays on the map without a visit.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_TIMEOUT_DAYS_MAXTip: Longest time the site stays on the map without a visit.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_EXIT_DAYSTip: Days until the map closes after success.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_REWARDTip: Factor on the usual quest reward.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_GOODWILL_FACTIONTip: Goodwill when the player hands the site back to its owners.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_GOODWILL_LOOTTip: Goodwill when the player keeps the loot.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_GOODWILL_PER_1000_SILVERTip: Goodwill lost for every 1000 silver worth of goods taken.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_APPROACH_ORDERTip: Order in the caravan menu. {0} is the site.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_APPROACHING_REPORTTip: Shown while the caravan is on its way. {0} is the site.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_ARRIVED_LETTER_DEFTip: Colour and sound of the arrival letter.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_FAILED_LABELTip: Title of the letter when the player leaves too early.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_FAILED_TEXTTip: Text of the letter when the player leaves too early.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_EXPIRED_LABELTip: Title of the letter when the site disappears unused.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_EXPIRED_TEXTTip: Text of the letter when the site disappears unused.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_FALLEN_LABELTip: Title of the letter when the defenders fall.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_FALLEN_TEXTTip: Text of the letter when the defenders fall.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_TagsTip: Any settlement type with one of these site tags can be built. The number shows how many types carry the tag.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_TriggerTip: Offers this quest in the running game at the current threat points.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_NotLoaded: The quest is not loaded yet. Restart the game.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_GenFailed: The quest could not be created here, for example because no site tile or quest giver was found.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_CannotRun: The quest cannot start right now. Usually a friendly faction with a leader and a matching settlement type is missing.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_RightHint: Saving writes the quest, its site and world object into Defs/CustomBaseFramework/Quests of your mod.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_LOST_LABELTip: Title of the letter when all prisoners are dead.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_F_LETTER_LOST_TEXTTip: Text of the letter when all prisoners are dead.
LanguageData.CBF_Qu_NeedRestart: Saved in this session. Restart the game so the quest loads with all its parts.
